findings.summary: Lag features (sales_lag1, sales_lag7, sales_mean7) use shift/rolling over the whole frame without groupby store_id, mixing sales across stores and producing wrong features that feed model training and MAE evaluation; first-week dropna also fails to drop per-store warm-up rows.
sales_lag7 only equals same weekday last week if there are no missing dates; gaps in a store's history shift it, so reindexing to a full daily range per store would be more robust.
